issues.on_page: Purchased Services 97,694.64 = Special Building 68,244.85 (2620-400, Maintenance of Buildings, p20) + Depreciation 29,449.79 (2900-400, p16)
issues.issue: Mixed function line: the dominant part (70%) is Building and Grounds, which is also how detail[187] classifies it. The user's school rule limits support services to Pupils and Staff. Options: re-categorize the line as Building and Grounds, or split it by the printed fund columns (p7).

The statement counts School Nutrition 3100-700 Equipment 4,420.97 as Capital Outlay, but detail[178] puts it under function food service. The amounts are right; only the function differs between the statement and the detail.

issues.on_page: Employee Benefit Fund 27,142.17; Statement of Activities (p3) shows it as Charges for Services under Employee Benefits, and its 'Allocation from General Fund' line holds only 295,000.00
issues.issue: The government-wide statement treats this as program charges for services (probably employee reimbursements), not a transfer. That weakens the transfer question in decision_needed[1]. The category comes from a user decision, so it is left as a warning.

issues.on_page: 2710 Vehicle Operation & Purchasing - Regular Education: Property 295,000.00 (spending)
issues.issue: Hidden-transfer treatment (also disbursements[29], detail[152], transfers_in/out): the report never eliminates or reclassifies this amount. The Statement of Activities (p3) keeps 463,875.19 as vehicle spending and 295,000 as a general receipt. Matching the Depreciation Fund 5200 receipt makes the treatment defensible, and it is already in decision_needed[0].

issues.on_page: Investment Income 58,981.62 = 1510 Interest lines only (General 37,632.31, Special Building 4,888.49, Depreciation 14,815.89, Activities 1,644.93)
issues.issue: Every component is interest, and the detail lines use Interest Income. Interest Income may fit better than investment income.
All Schedule M 'Other Items' lines are mapped to dues, training and travel. This is an assumption: the schedule does not say what they are.
